snippet.title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
(Re)discover the platforming classic, now enhanced with 4K visuals, new collectibles and rewards, plus a range of quality-of-life improvements.

Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition is included exclusively with every edition of Rayman Legends Retold. Pre-order now: raymanlegendsretold.com

About Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
Rediscover the iconic 2D platforming adventure, now enhanced with 4K visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and new collectibles to uncover. Play solo or jump into seamless 4-player couch co-op as you dash through more than 60 handcrafted levels filled with charm, secrets, and unforgettable challenges.

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
